source: United Nations Peace and Security Data Hub (DPPA-DPO), via the Humanitarian Data Exchange
source_table: HDX: dppadpo-ucpre2010 + peacekeeping-uniformed-contributions-by-gender; population World Bank SP.POP.TOTL
unit: uniformed personnel (annual mean of month-end counts); per million population
transformations: monthly totals over all missions and personnel types, averaged over the months reported in each year
peers with no rows in a year = 0
notes: The current calendar year averages the months published so far. Licence CC BY-IGO.
